Subala.note: King of Gandhara; father of Gandhari and Shakuni.

Gandhari.note: Princess of Gandhara; on marrying the blind Dhritarashtra she bound her own eyes for life. By a boon she bore a hundred sons and a daughter.

people.Shakuni: Prince of Gandhara, Gandhari's brother; master of the loaded dice, he engineered the Kauravas' schemes against the Pandavas.
people.Uluka: Son of Shakuni; the Kauravas' envoy to the Pandava camp.
